messages:
deploy-bot: kicking off staged deploy: service=inference-api, version=v2.3.1 -> rolling us-east-1 -> eu-west-1 -> ap-southeast-1. Change window 23:00-02:00 UTC. Canary 5% for 10m.

maria: ack. ops: @sre-oncall are we green on reserved pools & warm-ups? specifically EU capacity > 1.2x baseline?

aj: ran smoke suite on canary in us-east-1, all checks pass. p95 latency 82ms, error rate 0.1%. capacity headroom looks good. snippet of health checks:
```
OK /health 200
p95 82ms
pool_free_gpus 12
```

liam: eu-west-1 warm pool reports high job queueing. GPU thermal warnings on node gpu-eu-07.

sre-oncall: thanks. pausing EU cutover until we confirm queue drain. we have two options: 1) reduce canary to 2% and proceed, 2) pin eu to v2.2.9 and continue us/apac later. leaning to pin for EU.

maria: agree pin EU. we need to update routing policy to keep eu traffic on previous model and mark rollout state in console. aj can you enact pin and post the deploy-bot command?

aj: will do. executing pin now.
```
deploy-bot: route:set service=inference-api region=eu-west-1 version=v2.2.9 reason='thermal queueing'
deploy-bot: response ok
```

deploy-bot: us-east-1 canary progressed to 50% (10:12 UTC). ap-southeast-1 warmup staged but not cut over.

liam: monitoring EU queue; drain started, ETA ~8m. thermal alerts suppressed after retuning oversubscribe.

sre-oncall: set rollback gate: if p95>150ms or errors>1% for 5m, auto-rollback EU only. add manual hold for APAC until US stabilizes for 15m.

maria: update release notes: 'partial region pin: eu remains on v2.2.9 due to transient queueing; us progressed to v2.3.1 canary 50%.'

aj: noted. logging metrics in console: dashboard link: https://console.redwood.ai/d/rollouts/1735502468

ops: :thumbsup: for pin. continuing to watch. @sre-oncall ping if any regression + we'll schedule full roll in next window.

deploy-bot: deploy complete in us-east-1 at 10:25 UTC. eu pinned. apac held at warmup. thread closed unless new alerts.
